entries.zh: 悬挂（如吊灯般挂起）
entries.en: to hang (as one hangs a lamp)

entries.zh: 挂在手上或颈项上〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to hang from the hand or neck (pervueco = pescueço, neck)
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺，pervueco 应为 pescuezo（颈）之误写；M 栏亦残

entries.zh: 悬挂（如挂图像、神像般挂起）
entries.en: to hang (as one hangs an image/picture)

entries.zh: 打扣（挂在颈前带扣系结之物）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to fasten/hang by clasp at the front of the neck [残]
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺难解；R 栏 hà/quyě 有疑问标记，四栏互证不足

entries.zh: 扣号（挂在颈前并使之平贴）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to clasp (at the neck) and lay flat [残]
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺；汉字'扣号'与音写 quě hō 互证，但整句西语不完整

entries.zh: 把心挂在情人身上；相思牵挂（心有所悬）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to hang one's heart on a lover; to be lovesick [残]
entries.notes: 汉字'割/掛'有疑问，cūa 依音推为'挂'；西语词头残缺但语义可从 enamelorado(enamorado) 推断

entries.zh: 佩印（把印章挂在背后/背上佩带）
entries.en: to wear/hang a seal on one's back; to carry an official seal

entries.zh: 佩勅（把皇家敕令挂在背上佩带）
entries.en: to wear/hang the royal decree (imperial edict) on one's back
entries.notes: M 栏 chīt/fīt 有疑问标记，chīt 应为'勅'(敕)之音写

entries.zh: 旗竿缚（在长官门前旗杆上缚挂旗）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to hang the banner on the pole at the mandarin's gate [残]
entries.notes: 汉字'縛/索'有疑问，依音 zō 推为'縛'(缚)；语义'官署门前竖旗'清晰

entries.zh: 悬挂观看（挂起以供观看）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to hang up for display/viewing [残]
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺(oarzello 难解)；M 栏有两种异读且有疑问标记，语义仅可从'懸掛看'推断

entries.zh: 山谷；山窝（两山之间的凹地）
entries.en: a valley; a dell (hill-surrounded hollow)

entries.zh: 链；项链
entries.en: a chain; a necklace (collar)
entries.notes: M 栏 tō/zō 有疑问标记，依西语 Collar 与 R 栏 liěn(鍊) 定为'鍊'义

entries.zh: 风领（披颈部的毛皮领，围脖）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: a fur collar/neck-fur worn round the neck (wind-collar) [残]
entries.notes: M 栏音写残缺(T99)，依汉字'風領'与西语 Collar de pellexo 互证

entries.zh: 蜂巢；蜂窝（岫）
entries.en: a beehive; hive (nest-hollow)

entries.zh: 蜂岫；蜂窝
entries.en: a beehive (bee-nest)

entries.zh: 猪牙；猪獠牙〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: a pig's tusk/fang [残]
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[空]；西语 Colmillo de cochino 明确'猪牙'，但 R 栏音写残缺难证

entries.zh: 后枕；后脑勺（脑后枕部）
entries.en: the back of the head; occiput (colodrillo)

entries.zh: 颜色；色
entries.en: color

entries.zh: 羞赧之色；赧颜（借指羞色）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: color of shame/blush; (here glossed as) green [残]
entries.notes: 西语 color de verguença 义为'羞色'，而汉字'綠'与音 liog 为'绿'——西语义与字义不合，属词典特殊对应，存疑

entries.zh: 天色之色；苍色（青苍，天空之色）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: the color of the sky; azure/pale blue-green (蒼) [残]
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损，依汉字'蒼'与西语 color del cielo 互证；confidence 取 medium
